name: Tailscale VPN
description: Secure zero-config mesh VPN (WireGuard) enabling encrypted remote access to your 3D printer from any phone, tablet, or PC on your Tailnet without port forwarding.
author: Tailscale Inc.

changes: Use userspace-networking mode when kernel CONFIG_TUN is absent so tailscaled starts cleanly without kernel TUN or iptables
Configure writable cache and state directories under /usr/data/rosetteos/tailscale
Remove ASCII QR code output from TAILSCALE_UP macro in favor of a clean clickable authentication URL
Initial MIPS32EL static build of Tailscale v1.104.1 for RosetteOS
